english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for emphatic meanings such as total, perfect, unquestionable, or unrestricted.
Choose this when the emphasis is on something being absolute or indisputable rather than merely emphatic.

examples.english: I have absolute confidence that what he said is true.
examples.traditional: 我絕對相信佢講嘅係真話。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zyut6 deoi3 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 zan1 waa6

examples.english: This photo is veritable proof that he was there at the time.
examples.traditional: 呢張相絕對係證明佢當時喺場嘅實據。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 zyut6 deoi3 hai6 zing3 ming4 keoi5 dong1 si4 hai2 coeng4 ge3 sat6 geoi3
